title: The Host Is Always Right
text: The TaskMaster may award points for brilliance, effort, chaos, style, technical compliance, or vibes.

title: Read The Task Exactly
text: Once revealed, the task must be followed as written. Creative loopholes are allowed if they are funny enough.

title: Teams Win Together
text: Teams may help each other unless the task says otherwise. Sabotage is only legal when the room applauds.

title: No Hero Points
text: Skip or modify anything that feels unsafe. The funniest version is the one everyone can still laugh about tomorrow.
